bands.title: Legacy Complexity Blocking the Intelligence Your Business Needs
bands.lead: BFSI institutions carry decades of technology debt – disconnected core banking systems, claims platforms, CRM stacks, and regulatory warehouses resulting in slow decisions, compliance risk, and growing operational headcount

items.title: Fragmented core systems
items.body: Policy management, claims, CRM, and risk platforms that don’t talk to each other, creating data blind spots at critical decisioning moments

items.title: Slow underwriting & claims cycles
items.body: High-value practitioners bogged down in document review and manual data entry instead of risk assessment and relationship decisions

items.title: Customer data silos
items.body: 360-degree customer view is the aspiration, while disconnected product data, interaction history, and risk profiles make it a multi-year programme rather than a sprint

items.title: Portfolio intelligence gaps
items.body: Asset management and investment platforms generating data that isn’t being used for real-time portfolio intelligence or next-best-action decisioning
